note: Pinned by `bun run vendor:api-reference`. X-Factory serves scalar-api-reference.min.js from its own origin, so the API Reference works with no CDN (spec #241, ticket #247). The tarball's browser field is Scalar's self-contained standalone build: it inlines its chunks and its CSS. Its default web fonts are switched off in public/reference.html (withDefaultFonts: false), which is what keeps fonts.scalar.com off the wire.
